meta.title: Sectioned Feature Development
meta.description: Thin plan compiler and per-session external-subagent wrapper. Main owns scheduling, risk routing and acceptance.

cleanup.dirtyQuestion: The workspace has uncommitted changes. How should SFD proceed?
cleanup.sameBehind: main is strictly behind this branch (ahead>0, behind=0).
cleanup.sameAhead: main is strictly ahead of this branch (ahead=0, behind>0).
cleanup.diverged: This branch and main have diverged (ahead>0, behind>0).
cleanup.inSync: This branch is in sync with main (ahead=0, behind=0).
cleanup.newFromCurrent: New branch from the current branch
cleanup.ffToCurrent: Fast-forward main to this branch first

state.notGit: The working directory is not a Git repository.
state.notRootAgent: /sfd requires the exact live root chat agent.
state.noCwd: No working directory for this session.
state.esMissing: external-subagent is required but not detected. Install it first: brew install external-subagent (or see its README), then run `external-subagent agents enable zcode codex`.
state.esProfileMissing: Required external-subagent profile(s) missing: {names}. Create them or use the panel's profile installer.
state.resume: Existing SFD state detected — resuming handoff briefing follows.
state.fresh: No SFD state found in this repository.
state.handoff: You now drive the start: first read the sectioned-feature-development skill, then determine the task to build. If this conversation has no task context yet, ask the user what they want before doing anything else. Once the task is known, call the sfd_start tool with a one-line taskSummary — it runs the workspace cleanup (dirty-workspace handling, switching back to main when needed) and hands you the branch-base decision outcome. You name and create the feature branch (handle duplicate names); do not switch branches yourself before it hands the base decision back to you.
state.stopped: SFD start stopped by user. Nothing was changed in the repository state machine.
state.agentMergeHold: HOLD: merge the current branch with main and resolve conflicts first, then run /sfd again to resume.
state.nextPlan: Next: read the sectioned-feature-development skill, identify Feature(s) from the user request, and draft PLAN-FULL at .agent-work/PLAN-FULL.md. Automatic activation requires user approval of the first proportional plan before plan review.
state.legacyTitle: Existing SFD work markers found (no plugin state):
state.legacyBody: This may be an uncleaned previous run or a manual pre-plugin run. Decide: archive it and start fresh, continue it manually, or stop. The plugin cannot resume a run it did not record.
state.readSkillFirst: Read the sectioned-feature-development skill first, then continue from the phase above.

tool.existingRun: An SFD run already exists in this repository; use its brief above instead of starting a new one.
tool.agentMergeTask: Task for you: merge the current branch with main, resolve all conflicts, commit the merge, then call sfd_start again to proceed to planning.
tool.stoppedShort: The user stopped the SFD start. Do not continue the SFD flow.
tool.userNote:
Text the user typed into a cleanup card (not a commit message): {note}
Use it to decide the next step.
tool.performedDespiteStop: Before the stop, these operations already ran and changed the repository (for awareness only — do not continue the SFD flow):
tool.gitFailed: A programmatic git operation failed during cleanup. Full output follows.
tool.gitFailedAdvice: Read the error above, fix the cause (e.g. uncommitted changes blocking the switch), then call sfd_start again. Nothing has been persisted.
tool.createBranchFromMain: You now create the feature branch: name it and create it from main (handle duplicate names, ask the user when needed), then proceed to planning.
tool.createBranchFromCurrent: You now create the feature branch: name it and create it from the current branch {branch} (handle duplicate names, ask the user when needed), then proceed to planning.

intent.create-from-main: Base decision: start from main; the workspace is on main.
intent.new-from-main: Base decision: start from main; the workspace has been switched back to main.
intent.new-from-current: Base decision: start from the current branch.
intent.stay-current: Base decision: stay on the current branch.
intent.ff-main-to-current: main was fast-forwarded to the current branch; staying here.
intent.agent-merge: The current branch and main have diverged.
intent.note-only: The cleanup gate did not complete a base decision.
